$description: TicketStub master-brand tokens in the TicketStub token profile (not claimed as DTCG-compliant; see docs/token-profile.md). Stub editions have their own palettes in ticket-studio; these tokens cover the app UI, the logo and marketing only.

orange.$description: Primary. Calls to action, the logo stamp, the one orange accent in generated art. Large text only on cream (3.1:1); labels on orange use ink (5.0:1).

copper.$description: Secondary. Start of the foil gradient, premium details (print and frame tiers). Large text only on cream (3.6:1).

moss.$description: Secondary dark. Raised surfaces in the night stage: sheets, panels, the printing screen. Cream on moss is 11.6:1.

cyan.$description: Accent. End of the foil gradient, focus rings and selection on dark surfaces (9.5:1 on ink). Never used for text on cream.

cream.$description: Neutral light. Stub paper and the day theme background.

ink.$description: Neutral dark. Body text on cream (15.6:1) and the night stage background.

surface.$description: Ink at 5% over cream: chips, inputs, the drop zone. No extra colour.

text-muted.$description: Ink at 66%, resolves to #625D55 on cream, 5.6:1.
Cream at 66%, 7.3:1 on ink, 6.0:1 on moss.

foil.$description: Brand foil. Logo stamp, foil titles, the printing sweep.

holo-spectrum.$description: Full rainbow, used only for the holographic stock option. Multiplied into a greyscale plate (see docs/material-foil.md).

display.$description: Headlines, stub titles, the logo. Variable axes: opsz 9-144, wght 100-900, SOFT 0-100, WONK 0-1. OFL.

ui.$description: Interface, body copy, ticket data (use tabular-nums). OFL.

scale.$description: Major third (x1.25) from a 16px base, in rem.

paper.$description: A stub lying on the desk under low warm light.

lifted.$description: A stub being held or dragged.

glowRest.$description: Never 0: foil keeps a faint sheen at rest so it can't pop in.

sheenMaxOpacity.$description: Brand foil sheen, blend overlay. 0.32 with soft-light was too subtle.

settle.$description: Tilt returns to rest; card flip.

reveal.$description: Stub lands after printing; pin to the wall.

print-sweep.$description: Foil sweep loop while the stub is printing.

flip.$description: Symmetric, so the face swap lands edge-on.

smoothing.$description: Exponential smoothing time constants for foil inputs. Never step these values; see docs/material-foil.md.

spring.$description: Drag-spin release, stepped at a fixed rate so it settles the same on every display.
